arslantepe.name: Arslantepe Mound
arslantepe.slogan: Five thousand years of palaces stacked in one hill above the apricot orchards.
arslantepe.line: A UNESCO site since 2021, the mound yielded the oldest swords yet known, made around 3300–3000 BC.

hasanbeykayisi.name: Malatya Apricots
hasanbeykayisi.slogan: Sun-dried and honey-sweet, straight from the orchards of the Euphrates.
hasanbeykayisi.line: Malatya grows about 65 to 80 percent of the world's dried apricots.

harputkalesi.name: Harput Castle
harputkalesi.slogan: A rock fortress watching over the Euphrates plain for a thousand years.
harputkalesi.line: The fortress was built on a wide rock outcrop above the valley after 938, in the second Byzantine occupation.

munzurgozeleri.name: Munzur Springs
munzurgozeleri.slogan: Ice-clear water bursting from the rock in the heart of Dersim.
munzurgozeleri.line: The springs pour straight out of the mountainside to feed the Munzur river, and are held sacred by local Alevis.

somuncubaba.name: Somuncu Baba Complex
somuncubaba.slogan: A baker-saint's shrine tucked into the rocks of Darende.
somuncubaba.line: Hamid-i Veli, called Somuncu Baba or Father Loaf, ran a bakery beside his hermitage in Bursa and gave bread to the people.
